info.title: Text Utils API
info.summary: Reverse text, count and rank words, check palindromes and make slugs.
info.description: Five small text utilities, each one a single `POST` request with a JSON body.

post.description: Return the text with its characters in reverse order.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/reverse \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "Hello, Mintlify!"}'

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://localhost:8000/reverse",
    json={'text': 'Hello, Mintlify!'},
)
print(response.json())

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
Go

post.description:
Count words, unique words, characters and lines.

Words are runs of letters, digits, apostrophes and hyphens. Comparison
for `unique_words` ignores case.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/word-count \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "to be or not to be"}'

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://localhost:8000/word-count",
    json={'text': 'to be or not to be'},
)
print(response.json())

post.description: Check whether the text reads the same forwards and backwards.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"}'

response = requests.post(
    "http://localhost:8000/palindrome",

post.description:
Turn text into a lowercase, URL-friendly slug.

Accents are removed (`é` becomes `e`), anything that is not a letter or
digit is dropped, and words are joined with `separator`.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/slugify \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "Hello, Mintlify Docs!"}'

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://localhost:8000/slugify",
    json={'text': 'Hello, Mintlify Docs!'},
)
print(response.json())

post.description:
Return the most common words and how often each appears.

Counting ignores case. Ties keep the order the words first appeared in.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/word-frequency \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "to be or not to be", "top": 3}'

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://localhost:8000/word-frequency",
    json={'text': 'to be or not to be', 'top': 3},
)
print(response.json())

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to work on (up to 10,000 characters).

ignore_case_and_punctuation.title: Ignore Case And Punctuation
ignore_case_and_punctuation.description: When `true`, case, spaces and punctuation are ignored, so `A man, a plan, a canal: Panama` counts.

is_palindrome.title: Is Palindrome
is_palindrome.description: Whether the text reads the same forwards and backwards.

max_length.title: Max Length
max_length.description: Optional maximum slug length. Longer slugs are cut and any trailing separator is removed.
